name: Mnemo Agent API
description: HTTP API that gives embedding vectors a verifiable identity: embed (watermarked copy + vector_uid), verify (does this vector resolve to an object registered to your own namespace or account?), and lineage of parents you name at embed. Accountless: 0.01 USD per verify (USDC on Base via x402, or USDC.e on Tempo via MPP), or 500 verifications for 5.00 USD (x402, MPP Tempo, or a card via MPP and a Stripe Shared Payment Token); API keys: subscription, never x402. Own Mnemo-embedded vectors only; not a vector DB; no truth, authorship or ownership claims.
disambiguation: Mnemo here is the embedding-vector provenance API at trymnemo.com (GitHub MnemoProtocol; PyPI mnemo-protocol, imported as mnemo_sdk). It is not the unrelated PyPI packages mnemo, mnemo-sdk, mnemo-ai or mnemo-mcp, and not an AI-memory app or MCP server.

sdk.scope: account API-key path only (X-API-Key); no x402, no lineage

results.verify_scope: Mnemo Verify checks whether a submitted vector resolves to an object registered to the caller's Mnemo account or namespace. It cannot show whether a vector belongs to another party.
results.verified_true: The vector resolved to an object registered to the caller's namespace or account; vector_uid is that object's id.
results.verified_false: Attribution to one of the caller's registered objects could not be shown. A safe, charged outcome, not an error, and not proof that the vector belongs to someone else.
results.confidence: Diagnostic, not a probability. Decide on verified.
results.embed_output: watermarked_vector is a measurably perturbed, unit-length watermarked copy of the FP32 input; store and use it in place of the original.

not_for: vectors not embedded through Mnemo in your own namespace or account
checking whether a vector belongs to another party
generating embeddings, vector storage or similarity search
judging the truth, authorship, ownership or source model of content
file, image, code or text authenticity
personal data subject to EEA, UK or Swiss data protection law over accountless access (any payment rail)
availability: If POST /v1/agent/namespaces answers 404, accountless access is not enabled on this deployment.

pricing.summary: 0.01 USD per healthy verification, whether the result is positive or negative, paid in USDC on Base via x402 or in USDC.e on Tempo via MPP; or 500 verifications for 5.00 USD (burst_500). Discover what a namespace can buy now from payment_menu (GET /v1/agent/namespace).
pricing.unit: one healthy completed verification (verified true or false)
pricing.asset: USDC (x402, Base) or USDC.e (MPP, Tempo); USD on a card (burst_500 only)
not_charged: a verification Mnemo fails to complete (503)

offers.note: Not sold over a card: Stripe's minimum card charge rules out 0.01 USD. Never sold to a funded namespace.

offers.semantics: Credits expire at funded_until (14 days after settlement). A refill gives a fresh 500 and a fresh window; credits and time never stack. For 24 hours after funded_until verify (402 funded_window_ended) and embed (410) are refused, but the namespace is not gone: its capability works, data is kept through retained_until and a refill reopens it. Buy at least 15 minutes before the namespace stops being usable (expires_at, or retained_until for a refill). A replayed payment grants nothing again. No automatic refunds.
offers.capacity_refusal: 503 funded_capacity_unavailable with Retry-After: 300 and no payment challenge: nothing offered, nothing charged. payment_menu can still list burst_500 at that moment.

stripe_spt.instrument: card via a Stripe Shared Payment Token

rails.rule: Pay exactly one challenge from the 402; take amount, asset and recipient from it. No rail is required. Pay MPP challenges with a standard MPP client: a Tempo transfer must carry the attribution memo bound to the challenge, so never build it by hand.

payment.note: x402 rail details. x402 is one of several rails; see rails and offers.
payment.pay_to: Take payTo and amount from the 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; do not hard-code them.

account_api_key.billing: the account's subscription plan (https://www.trymnemo.com/pricing): included monthly verifications, no automatic overage, no top-ups, never x402

request_id: omit it on a paid verify (the payment identifies the operation; retries resend the identical body); elsewhere optional, not scoped to a namespace, kept 24 hours: use a fresh random UUID

capabilities.summary: create an ephemeral namespace (JSON body; {} is enough); returns the capability once
state, expiry, usage, limits; payment_menu (what this namespace can buy now, and over which rails); on a funded namespace funded_until, retained_until and retained_seconds_remaining
watermark and register a vector; optional verified parent

capabilities.cost: with a capability: 0.01 USD per healthy verification (x402 or MPP Tempo), or one burst_500 credit; with an API key: the account's plan, never x402
capabilities.summary: does this vector resolve to an object registered to this namespace or account

capabilities.cost: 5.00 USD (x402, MPP Tempo or MPP card)
capabilities.summary: buy burst_500 for this namespace: 500 verifications, a 14-day funded window, a 100,000,000-byte storage allowance; 200 returns offer, credits_granted and funded_until

optional, human-assisted handoff (agents never need it): promote to a permanent account; identities and lineage preserved; does not start the free trial (the issued API key uses the account's subscription plan)

retention_after_promotion_days.free_trial_note: Free trial objects are kept until the trial ends (at most 30 days); Customer Content is then deleted after a 7-day grace period unless the account moves to a paid plan.

legal.acceptance: Access to or use of the Mnemo API through an automated agent, application, script, SDK, protocol client, wallet, autonomous system, or other automated means constitutes access to and use of the Services by the person or entity that operates, controls, authorizes, deploys, or causes that system to access the Services, and acceptance of the Mnemo Terms of Service (Terms 1.2 and 1.5).
legal.patents: The Mnemo technology is patent pending.
legal.licensing: The MIT License applies only to the example files listed in examples/LICENSE of the Mnemo SDK repository (https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-sdk/blob/main/examples/LICENSE). The SDK is under the Mnemo SDK License; protocol documentation may be used only to build software that interoperates with the Services.

commercial_terms.free_trial: Accounts only. At most 30 days from activation, with 10,000 verifications in total; ends earlier when that allowance is used. Not a perpetual free plan. No rollover, no re-grant, no top-up, no automatic overage and no x402 fallback; never converts to a paid plan automatically.
commercial_terms.paid_plans: Monthly plans with an included verification allowance that resets each billing period. No automatic overage charges and no top-ups. Plans renew monthly until cancelled.
commercial_terms.api_key_x402: Calls authenticated with an account API key use the account's plan and never fall back to x402.
commercial_terms.x402_entitlement: If an x402 payment settles but the verification cannot be executed, a paid entitlement to one verification is recorded for that namespace. It is bound to the namespace, non-transferable, non-redeemable for money, USDC or any other asset, has no monetary value, and expires with the namespace.
